findings.reason: Correctness defect in a goal-named path: the render lane can stall permanently.
Correctness defect in a goal-named path: a supersede/reset gap can permanently stall the render lane with no resync.
DoS/resource-pinning hardening against unauthenticated peers; the goal states no security/DoS requirement.
Hardening (cap on concurrent pre-auth connections); not a goal-behavior defect.
Covered predictions wrongly trip the timeout and disable prediction, against the Phase 4 design.
Unbounded local memory only when the UI client is stalled; hardening.
Unbounded DNS lookup and ignored stop let a QUIC attempt exceed the goal's 3 s bound.
Migration on the same connection is never verified by a round trip that needs the migrated path.
Fallback test never checks that QUIC was tried first.
Missing timing_lock; can only flake, never false-pass.
Missing tests for pre-auth DoS bounds; hardening.
